**Summary**

I resolved ticket T-4003 by identifying that the cart-service Service selector incompatibility caused the outage. The new cart-service 4.2 deployment uses Kubernetes standard labels (`app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`) from the Helm chart template, but the Service still uses the old selector format (`app: cart-service`). This label mismatch prevents the Service from finding any backend pods, causing all cart requests to fail with "connection refused" errors. The fix is to update the Service selector to use `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`.
